name: dumbbell sumo squat (back on stability ball wall)
description: A wide-stance sumo squat holding a dumbbell with a stability ball between your back and the wall. The ball supports your back and keeps your posture upright.
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and lean your lower back on it.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of you and set your feet wide with toes turned out.
Squat down as the ball rolls up your back.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
